WITH base AS (
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', analytics_calendar_months.observed_at) AS "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", MEASURE(analytics_calendar_months.amount) AS "current"
  FROM analytics_calendar_months
  WHERE (analytics_calendar_months.observed_at >= '2024-01-01' AND analytics_calendar_months.observed_at <= '2024-03-31')
  GROUP BY 1
),
calendar_keys AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" AS "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", base."current" AS "current", DATE_ADD(base."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", INTERVAL '-1 month') AS "__calendar_1"
  FROM base
),
compared AS (
SELECT
  t."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" AS "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", t."current" AS "current", cmp_1."current" AS "prior"
  FROM calendar_keys t LEFT JOIN calendar_keys cmp_1 ON cmp_1."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" = t."__calendar_1"
),
calendar_keys_2 AS (
SELECT
  compared."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" AS "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", compared."current" AS "current", compared."prior" AS "prior", DATE_ADD(compared."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", INTERVAL '-1 month') AS "__calendar_1"
  FROM compared
),
compared_2 AS (
SELECT
  t."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" AS "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", t."current" AS "current", t."prior" AS "prior", cmp_1."prior" AS "prior_twice"
  FROM calendar_keys_2 t LEFT JOIN calendar_keys_2 cmp_1 ON cmp_1."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" = t."__calendar_1"
  WHERE (t."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" >= '2024-03-01' AND t."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" <= '2024-03-31')
)
SELECT
  compared_2."analytics_calendar_months.observed_at" AS "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at", compared_2."current" AS "current", compared_2."prior" AS "prior", compared_2."prior_twice" AS "prior_twice", ((CAST((compared_2."current" - compared_2."prior_twice") AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / NULLIF(compared_2."prior_twice", 0)) AS "growth"
  FROM compared_2
  ORDER BY "analytics_calendar_months.observed_at"
  LIMIT 10

    (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_calendar_alignment WHERE tenant='A' AND lane='months' AND observed_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-02-01T00:00:00Z' AND observed_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-03-01T00:00:00Z') AS prior,
    (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_calendar_alignment WHERE tenant='A' AND lane='months' AND observed_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND observed_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-02-01T00:00:00Z') AS prior_twice) SELECT bucket,current,prior,prior_twice,(current-prior_twice)/prior_twice AS growth FROM truth;
